label: arm_wording_extra
rule: Default and firm clauses, forecast written from token counts before any output of the run is scored. w(m, d, t): share of model m's requested-direct outputs longer than 16 generated tokens; for the four arm-wording clauses from the mechanism forecast (arm-wording screen), for the default and firm clauses from this run's pilot (the arm-wording screen's items and two configurations, 100 requested outputs per model, clause and task). Predicted gain over the requested arm in the three forms of the mechanism forecast (pooled (1 - w) g_F, short-stratum (1 - w) g_S, partial (1 - rho w) g_F), with g_F, g_S and rho taken unchanged from the mechanism forecast. Statements A1-A5 of src/arm_wording_extra.py with W_NEAR0 = 0.05, GAP_TOL_PP = 2.0, W_CORR = 0.9, W_RANGE = 0.2; S1-S5 of src/arm_wording_mechanism.py over the six clauses with TOL = 0.05. Strict scores on the arm-wording run's six configurations; chain of thought from its scored table, every trigger.

statements.S1_clause_reversal_six_clauses: per task, the observed clause-only reversal share of the requested arm lies within 0.05 of the predicted range
statements.S2_clause_vs_template_six_clauses: per task, the clause-only reversal share exceeds the configuration-only reversal share of the requested arm
statements.S3_arm_switch_six_clauses: per task and clause, the observed arm-switch share lies within 0.05 of the predicted range
statements.S4_requested_rises_six_clauses: per task, among models whose screen w ranges over at least 0.2: (a) the pooled within-model slope of requested accuracy on w is positive; (b) more than half of those models have a positive slope
statements.S5_forced_steadier_six_clauses: per task: (a) the median over models of the across-clause SD of forced accuracy is smaller than that of requested accuracy; (b) forced varies less than requested in more than half of the models
statements.A1_forced_meets_requested: per task, among models whose pilot w under the firm clause is at most 0.05: (a) the mean requested minus forced accuracy under the firm clause lies within 2.0 pp of 0; (b) within 2.0 pp in more than half of them
statements.A2_default_more_working: per task, on the collections' own requested outputs: (a) the median over models of w(default) - w(current) is positive; (b) positive in more than half of models
statements.A3_firm_less_working: per task: (a) the median of w(firm) - w(current) is negative; (b) negative in more than half of models
statements.A4_pilot_predicts_w: per task, the pilot's and the collection's w under the two new clauses correlate at least 0.9 over models x clauses
statements.A5_extrapolates_to_forced: per task, among models whose w ranges over at least 0.2 across the six clauses, the median within-model intercept of requested minus forced accuracy on w (pooled slope) lies within 2.0 pp of 0

note: read the pilot's token counts (no correctness) and the mechanism forecast; written before any output of this run was scored.
